title: Order XLVII Rule 1 CPC — Review grounds

content.overview: Review needs new evidence that due diligence missed, an error apparent on the face of the record, or another sufficient reason.
content.study: An error apparent is a howler, not a fresh argument. Sufficient reason is analogous, not a spare appeal. Section 114 is the parent.
